purpose: Decisive low-budget probe of whether genuine pre-pooling 12x12 V-JEPA detail adds activity information beyond a matched repeated 3x3 control.

population.split: locked scenario/recording grouped folds from memory_data.npz

inputs.time_contract: tubelet midpoints are the means of consecutive source-frame pairs, centered on the metadata frame at nominal 30 fps
inputs.quality: six observable geometry/validity values, standardized from outer-training rows only

representation.coarse_control: repeat each 3x3 token into its 4x4 block and pass the same 3x3 coarse_reference
representation.fine_candidate: genuine 12x12 tokens with the identical 3x3 coarse_reference

training.loss: center-label cross-entropy with inverse-square-root outer-training class weights, normalized to mean one
training.selection: no inner selection; all values frozen before outer fitting
training.normalization: per-channel mean/std from outer-training coarse tokens, reused for fine, repeated-coarse and coarse_reference inputs; epsilon 1e-5

evaluation.primary: fine_both versus coarse_control standalone macro-F1 on outer-held rows
evaluation.blend: descriptive arithmetic mean only; no weight or threshold selection
evaluation.promotion: not authorized; a positive probe only authorizes a fresh nested ARFTR-preserving integration design

advance: fine_both beats coarse_control by at least 0.005 macro-F1
fine_both improves in at least 4 of 5 outer folds
fine_both contributes at least 25 unique ARFTR-error rescues with no more than 1.5 harms/rescue
fixed blend is no worse than ARFTR by 0.002 macro-F1
go_no_go.close: otherwise close the fine-density branch and do not widen epochs, ranks, seeds, matching or ablations

leakage_controls: outer-held labels are not indexed by optimizer updates
normalization and class weights use outer-training rows only
ARFTR probabilities are opened after all candidate fits solely for fixed-blend/error accounting
no annotation-derived support, human-review field, scenario or track identity enters the model
all saved probabilities are joined by exact sample IDs and held-row indices

compute_boundary.timing_smoke: one fold, one arm, 128 training rows, one optimizer update; no scientific score
compute_boundary.full_probe: 10 fixed outer fits, two epochs, projected below 20 minutes
